description: React component for the header of a modal that manages user groups, including actions like adding users, restoring groups, and displaying group info.

methods.name: goToAddPeopleModal
methods.description: Opens modal to add users to group and exits current modal.

methods.name: restoreGroup
methods.description: Calls action to restore the group.

methods.name: showSubMenu
methods.description: Determines if sub menu should be shown based on permissions.

methods.name: modalTitle
methods.description: Renders the modal title with group display name and archive icon if applicable.

methods.name: addPeopleButton
methods.description: Renders 'Add people' button if permission allows.

methods.name: restoreGroupButton
methods.description: Renders 'Restore Group' button if permission allows.

methods.name: subMenuButton
methods.description: Renders sub menu component if applicable.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Handles back button click, invoking callback and closing modal.
